title: Glowing envelope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='55%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7c2' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffcc00' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='envBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe98a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f7c948'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='envFlap' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff4b8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd84d'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <rect x='20' y='34' width='60' height='40' rx='5' fill='url(#envBody)'/>

  <polygon points='20,74 44,54 56,54 80,74' fill='#ffdf6e'/>

  <polygon points='20,39 50,60 80,39' fill='none' stroke='#fff6cc' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='4.5' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
